en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large traditional building on a slope, with multiple gabled roofs, dormer windows, shutters, and a central balcony/loggia. Leafless trees stand in front of a low wall and the house, suggesting late autumn or winter. Printed German text appears in the upper left corner identifying the place and the establishment 'Klause Steinberg', a wine and coffee tavern in Meissen-Spaar.
